standard: User-approved 90-degree overhead seated pose, thigh length based on the approved 85% version. Transparent PNGs. Separate source art; existing game textures and configuration are unchanged.

files.role: Rifle infantry; reused approved seated master
files.prompt: Precise small proportion edit of this transparent pixel-art seated American infantry sprite. This supplied image is the ORIGINAL LENGTH BASELINE, defined as 100%. Create an 85% THIGH LENGTH version: shorten each visible thigh by ONLY 15 percent relative to this supplied baseline. Do not shorten by 25 percent. Keep the upper end of each thigh fixed where it emerges below the rifle/lap; move each knee end and tiny brown boot tip upward by approximately 40 pixels on this canvas. Approximate original thigh span is y=825 to y=1105 (280 pixels); target span is about 238 pixels, ending near y=1063. Coordinates are internal editing guidance only, no text or marks. Retain the existing leg WIDTH, knee shape, slight outward splay and distinct gap between thighs; only reduce their longitudinal length moderately. It should be visibly longer than a 75%-length version while slightly shorter than the supplied image. Preserve the helmet, backpack, shoulders, sleeves, arms, hands, rifle, upper-body size and position, palette and coarse chunky pixel clusters as closely as possible. Same canvas and transparent margins. Preserve STRICT EXACT 90-degree overhead orthographic view: no face, chest, belly or front-facing torso. Two thighs project forward in a seated pose on an invisible tank edge, lower legs hang vertically and are occluded from above, only small boot tips beyond knees. Single character only, genuine transparent background, no tank, seat, ledge, ground, external shadows, labels or guides. Change only thigh length to 85% of this reference.

Use case: style-transfer. Produce AmericanInfantry02 seated variant as one transparent pixel-art game sprite. Image 1 is the APPROVED SEATED POSE, CAMERA, PROPORTIONS AND STYLE MASTER; image 2 is the ORIGINAL AmericanInfantry02 WEAPON AND EQUIPMENT IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY, not its camera. Transform the original soldier into the exact seated geometry of master image 1. Preserve master image 1's exact 90-degree straight-down orthographic view, helmet size and location, shoulder silhouette, forward-projecting thighs, knee locations, tiny visible boot tips, and thigh length. This master already has the approved 85%-length thighs; DO NOT shorten them or lengthen them further. Replace master's wooden service rifle with the distinctive black-metal and brown-wood AUTOMATIC RIFLE seen in reference 2: same receiver silhouette, long barrel, box magazine and wood furniture, recognizable as reference 2's weapon, not a generic M1 Garand, not an assault rifle. Rest it obliquely across the seated soldier's lap, hands gripping it naturally, with muzzle pointing lower right and buttstock toward upper left; adapt only forearms and hands where necessary. Retain reference 2's net-covered olive M1 helmet and khaki webbing; shoulder patch only on upward-visible sleeve area, if visible. Image 2's visible face and chest MUST NOT appear. Strict exact 90-degree camera directly above: helmet crown completely occludes torso, only helmet, tops of shoulders, arms, hands and thighs visible; NO face, chin, chest, abdomen or frontal torso panel. Soldier sits on an invisible tank edge, two horizontal thighs project forward, hanging shins are occluded and only tiny brown boot tips peek out. Match the master pixel art closely, hard square-pixel clusters, heavy near-black outlines, few large muted olive and khaki shade groups; no smooth painting or perspective tilt. Same canvas dimensions, same upper-body scale and alignment as image 1, complete isolated character, ample transparent margins, genuine alpha background. No tank, seat, ledge, ground, external cast shadow, labels, text, guides or extra characters. Final image must clearly be the same coherent seated sprite set as master 1 but with original soldier 2's distinctive automatic rifle and equipment.

Use case: style-transfer. Produce AmericanInfantry03 seated variant as one transparent pixel-art game sprite. Image 1 is APPROVED SEATED CAMERA, POSE, SCALE, AND THIGH-LENGTH MASTER; image 2 is ORIGINAL AmericanInfantry03 IDENTITY, WEAPON AND EQUIPMENT reference only, not its camera or standing pose. Create original soldier 3 sitting in the exact overhead geometry of image 1. Preserve image 1's helmet center/size, shoulder span, forward-projecting thighs, slight natural splay, knee positions, tiny brown boot tips, seated compact proportions. Image 1 already contains the approved 85%-length thighs: do not lengthen or shorten them. Change the helmet to soldier 3's PLAIN SMOOTH OLIVE M1 HELMET, without netting, with broad simple pixel shading. Keep soldier 3's characteristic khaki backpack/bedroll and small olive grenade equipment where visible from overhead. Replace the service rifle with ONE LONG OLIVE-GREEN WWII BAZOOKA from image 2, distinctive long cylindrical tube, small fittings, subtle brown sling, clearly recognizable as the original soldier 3's weapon. Rest the bazooka diagonally across his lap, rear end toward upper-left and open muzzle toward lower-right; both hands naturally support it, adjust forearms only as needed. Keep the complete weapon inside canvas with transparent margins, not clipping its ends. Do not aim it toward the camera. STRICT EXACT 90-DEGREE VERTICAL OVERHEAD ORTHOGRAPHIC CAMERA: show only crown of helmet, shoulder tops, arms, hands and seated thighs. Helmet occludes torso, NO face, chin, neck, chest, belly or frontal uniform. The source image 2's face and front of jacket must NOT appear. Thighs rest horizontally forward on an invisible tank deck and lower legs hang vertically over an unseen edge, invisible from directly above apart from tiny brown boot tips beyond knees. Coarse chunky pixel art, large hard square pixel clusters, bold near-black outline, muted olive/khaki/brown palette consistent with master, no smooth illustration, no fine rendering, no gradient, no perspective tilt. Same canvas dimensions and upper-body alignment as master image 1. One isolated seated American bazooka soldier, genuine transparent background, no tank, seat, ledge, ground, external cast shadow, labels, text, guides or extra characters.
files.cleanupPrompt: Precise local pixel-art cleanup of supplied sprite. Remove ONLY the tiny tan/peach triangular exposed chin/face patch directly below the front center of the helmet, near x=605 y=707 in the supplied approximately 1168x1360 canvas. In strict 90-degree overhead view no face or chin should be visible. Replace this tiny triangle with the same deep dark olive/near-black occlusion shade surrounding it, so the helmet occludes the face completely. Preserve absolutely everything else as close to pixel-identical as possible: helmet, shoulders, backpack, bazooka and sling, arms, hands, legs and knee positions, current thigh length, tiny boots, coarse square pixels, outlines, canvas size and character alignment. Do NOT change proportions, pose, equipment, colors elsewhere, camera or seated silhouette. Keep genuine transparent background. No visible skin anywhere except the existing hands. No other additions.
